Remote Work

8. FAQ
Q: Can interns work remotely?
A: Interns are not eligible for remote work and must work from the Bengaluru office.
Q: How many casual leaves are allowed?
A: Employees are allowed 12 casual leaves per year.
Q: Can I carry forward earned leave?
A: Yes, up to 10 days of earned leave can be carried forward to the next calendar
year.
